## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The option-boundary handling should be fixed because a bare `--json` before `--junit` breaks the advertised combination.

## Changes
The pull request adds default and explicit JSON destinations, a report-writing function, and tests for individual JSON and JUnit options.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Preserve following options when JSON has no path — For `["--json", "--junit", "x.xml"]`, the parser consumes `--junit` as the JSON destination, then raises `ValueError("unknown option: x.xml")`. The destination check only tests whether another argument exists. — Users combining the default JSON destination with a following JUnit option cannot generate their reports. — Fix: Consume the next argument only when it is a path, using the existing `--junit` option-boundary check as a guide.
